extensionDescription.message: This extension applies visual effects to web pages to simulate the browsing experience of people with accessibility-related needs.

popupIntroduction.message: Choose a persona to simulate the experience of a web user with accessibility-related needs.

ashleighDescription.message: A severely sight-impaired person with a screen reader.

ashleighInstructionBlur.message: The current tab's content is now blurred to simulate Ashleigh's sight impairment.

ashleighInstructionScreenReader.message: Open a screen reader on your device to experience how Ashleigh navigates the page.

ashleighInstructionScreenReaderMac.message: On Mac, you can use the native screen reader VoiceOver by pressing Cmd + F5.

ashleighInstructionScreenReaderWindows.message: On Windows, you can use the native screen reader Narrator by pressing the Windows logo key + Ctrl + Enter.

pawelDescription.message: An autistic person who is easily distracted when browsing the web.

pawelWarning.message: Loud sounds will be played during the simulation. Please check your volume.

pawelInstructionDistractions.message: You'll see moving text and images, simulating Pawel's distractions. Make sure your sound is turned on to hear audio distractions as well. Pawel uses a color theme that helps him focus on the content.

pawelMessage02.message: I have to get back to work soon...

pawelMessage03.message: The ventilation sounds a lot today. bzzzzzz

pawelMessage04.message: Should I answer that text message?

pawelMessage05.message: Must concentrate, must concentrate, must concentrate

simoneDescription.message: A dyslexic person who needs more time to understand text and forms.

simoneInstructionScrambledText.message: The text in the current tab is being scrambled to simulate Simone's experience with dyslexia. A screen ruler helps her read the text. Simone also uses a colored overlay to reduce visual stress. The font is changed to Atkinson Hyperlegible, which helps people with dyslexia recognize letters more easily.

simoneInstructionReadParagraphs.message: Try to read paragraphs or navigate forms with this setting. Notice which parts of the page are especially hard to read.

ronDescription.message: An older person with a hand tremor and no assistive technology.

ronInstructionShakingCursor.message: The cursor is now shaking, simulating Ron's tremor.

ronInstructionCursorVisibility.message: If the original cursor is still visible, try moving it to the address bar and back in.

claudiaDescription.message: A sight-impaired person who uses a screen magnifier.

claudiaInstructionMagnification.message: Claudia needs to magnify the page content to see everything clearly. The current tab is now zoomed in to 200%. High contrast mode is enabled.

claudiaInstructionSystemSettingsMac.message: Set your mouse cursor to maximum size to improve the simulation. To do this, go to “Accessibility > Display” in the system settings.

claudiaInstructionSystemSettingsWindows.message: Set your mouse cursor to maximum size to improve the simulation. To do this, go to “Accessibility > Mouse pointer and touch” in the system settings.

chrisDescription.message: A person with rheumatoid arthritis who mostly uses his keyboard.

chrisInstructionColorPerception.message: Because Chris has trouble seeing colors, your tab is shown in grayscale. The mouse cursor is hidden since Chris uses the keyboard for navigation.

chrisInstructionCursorVisibility.message: If the cursor is still visible, try moving it to the address bar and back in.

chrisInstructionKeyboardNavigation.message: Put your mouse aside and only use the keyboard to navigate the page. Use the TAB and ENTER keys and pay attention to the order in which elements are selected.

saleemDescription.message: A Deaf person whose main language is German Sign Language.

saleemInstructionMute.message: The current tab is now muted to simulate Saleem's experience with profound deafness.

saleemInstructionVideo.message: Check if videos have descriptive captions or transcripts. It's easiest for Saleem to receive information in British Sign Language (BSL). Check if the website provides different contacting options or offers a relay service in BSL.
